market.rules_primary: If Saquon Barkley scores the first touchdown in Philadelphia vs Tennessee Pro Football game originally scheduled for Sep 20, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
market.rules_secondary:
The following market refers to Saquon Barkley in the Philadelphia vs Tennessee professional football game originally scheduled for Sep 20, 2026. If Saquon Barkley is active but never takes a snap, the market settles to the fair market price before game start. Once Saquon Barkley takes at least one snap, even if nullified by penalty, the market settles based on touchdowns scored. If no touchdowns are scored in the game, the No Touchdown market resolves to Yes and all other player markets resolve to No.
